scope: Direct public sources for research and development; downloads do not confer legal fishing clearance or current safety status.

sources.role: Public taxonomic name lookup smoke check, independent of regional presence
sources.rights: Taxonomic facts/reference only; occurrence data and images retain their own dataset/record licenses. This lookup does not provide diet, current Cavite presence or catchability.

sources.role: Live source-dataset metadata for the existing CAS Ichthyology occurrence shortlist
sources.rights: Preserve source citation and the returned dataset license; still inspect each occurrence license and locality/uncertainty. A successful metadata lookup does not establish current local species presence.

sources.role: Public accepted-name lookup smoke check for an existing research candidate
sources.rights: WoRMS taxonomic text attribution applies; images have different terms. No local-presence, diet/bait or legal inference from taxonomic acceptance.

sources.role: Dated administrative outline for discovery only
sources.rights: geoBoundaries gbOpen attribution required; preserve the original source license returned in boundaryLicense. This derivative is simplified and is not a legal municipal-water boundary.

sources.role: Original distributor metadata and direct download catalog
sources.rights: CC BY-IGO as declared by the HDX dataset; metadata_modified and resource upload dates are not the date of a boundary survey.

sources.role: Provincial dated fishery context and ordinance leads
sources.rights: Keep the full PDF as a local research copy; no blanket map/photograph/database redistribution license was verified. Attribute extracted facts and preserve the Office of the Provincial Agriculturist source.

sources.role: Comprehensive Fishery Ordinance source text; read with 292-2023
sources.rights: Official legal text: RA8293 section 175 is relevant. Do not extend this to a blanket GIS or third-party image license. Current applicability still requires amendment/effectivity review.

sources.role: Section 7 amendment and printed local-zone waypoint tables
sources.rights: Official legal text reference; coordinate datum and current effectivity remain unconfirmed. Local zones are not the outer boundary of Cavite municipal waters.

sources.role: National fisheries statute text and section-level references
sources.rights: Official legal text reference under RA8293 section 175; reconcile subsequent rules and applicability.

sources.role: 2024 amendment to FAO208; official filed copy from the UP Law Center repository
sources.rights: Official legal text reference. NARO is a research repository, not a certified copy service. Read the base order and scanned amendment before encoding conditions.

sources.role: 2023 mangrove-crab amendment; official filed copy from the UP Law Center repository
sources.rights: Official legal text reference; read with base FAO264 and review scanned conditions.

sources.role: Official weather page snapshot and source link
sources.rights: Local research snapshot. Public bulk reuse terms not verified. Retrieval time is not advisory issue time and this snapshot is not a live safety determination.

sources.role: Official gale-warning page snapshot and source link
sources.rights: Local research snapshot; read the issue/validity time and exact affected seaboards. Do not infer safety from a failed or stale response.

sources.role: Official current bulletin discovery page; its URL slug is historical
sources.rights: Local research snapshot. Bulletin dates, tested waters and shellfish/Acetes consumption scope need review; this is not a blanket fishing ban or all-species food-safety assessment.
